description: Three skills that surface unstated assumptions before they derail the work — ask-me, step-by-step and fresh-start. Runs natively in Claude and ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Surface the assumption before it derails the work.
interface.longDescription: Three portable agent skills for Claude and ChatGPT. Most disappointing AI output is an unstated assumption, not a model failure: these surface it before the work starts, break big tasks into visible steps, and condense a spent chat into a clean restart. No prompt engineering required.
